note: Known divergence between Blitz and Chromium on the text-free corpus. run_parity.py exits 1 on a NEW divergence, on a delta that grew, on a baseline entry that no longer diverges (update this file in the commit that fixes it), and on any missing box. Rewrite with --update-baseline and read the diff before committing it. The seven table-collapse entries are a residual of collapsed-border edge accounting, 2-4px on box position and width, not a row-height defect: in standards mode Chromium paints the table 106px tall and Blitz 104px. They were 18px apart until 2026-11-17, when the harness was found to be rendering Chromium without a DOCTYPE (quirks mode) while Blitz always lays out in standards mode; the four br-run-blocks entries vanished entirely with the doctype added. They are pinned so that a REGRESSION in table layout still reddens, and so that an improvement fails until this file is updated in the same commit.
